instruction.text: What do you think the barons did after becoming so angry with King John?

b.sound: They formed an army and marched towards London to force King John to change things.
They gave up and sat at home.

instruction.text: How do you think King John reacted to the barons marching towards London?

feedback.end: King John met the barons in Runnymede, just outside of London. This is where the Magna Carta was signed.

b: ++He met the barons to make peace.

instruction.text: Read this conversation between King John and a baron. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: The Magna Carta has 63 ((++clauses lies)) about what you, as the King, are allowed to do. You need to make sure that you follow them.

There will be a group of 12 barons to make sure you ((++follow ignore)) the rules. Otherwise, we will go to war with you.
